coverage_gap=The 1655 `(struct X *)skb->data` cast sites in net/ and drivers/net/ were enumerated but not individually audited for a later free/handoff followed by a dereference of the cast pointer; only the top window-scanner hits and known fact-card shapes (vcan/vxcan, garp excluded as other branch) were read.
coverage_gap=Non-net trees (fs/, netfilter helpers outside net/, drivers/ outside drivers/net/) were not searched per branch instructions, and pskb_may_pull/pskb_expand_head/skb_cow_head reallocation sites were deliberately excluded because other branches cover them.
limitation=The single finding is a stored dangling pointer with no demonstrated dereference site in this snapshot: chan->data is written at net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c:447 by send_pkt() but no reader of chan->data for the 6lowpan IPSP channel could be found in s04, so no crash or disclosure is proven; it is reported as a low-confidence hypothesis.
limitation=No build, KASAN, or reproducer run was performed (read-only source snapshot; all work confined to grep, Python-assisted scanning, and source reading), so every conclusion rests on static reading of s04's exact lines.
limitation=The scanner's function-extent heuristic (column-0 braces), 450-line body cap, 100-line use window, and single-line derivation matching can mis-scope large functions and miss multi-line or indirect derivations (e.g., pointers passed through intermediate locals), so false negatives among the 5321 free-call sites cannot be excluded.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s04 as supplied, and no git history exists to check whether upstream has since fixed net/bluetooth/6lowpan.c.
limitation=The seed location net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb exhibits the save/pull/deref shape in s04 but is excluded from reporting by assignment rules, and pskb_may_pull-induced head-reallocation variants are out of scope for this branch.
